input.postNavigationHooks: [async function ownedReadiness({page,request}){if(!request.userData.case_id.startsWith('cs-'))return;const mode=await page.evaluate(()=>document.querySelector('#target')?.dataset.mode);if(mode==='expand'||mode==='load-more'){await page.evaluate(()=>{const button=document.querySelector('#reveal');if(!button)throw Error('Owned reveal missing');button.click();});}await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.ready==='true'&&document.querySelector('.product'),null,{timeout:8000});}]
